title: F in the editor: the Frame tool or full screen
goal: In the player F now fills the screen. In the editor F still picks the Frame tool. The user decides whether F should fill the screen in the editor too, the way Photoshop's F changes the screen mode, which would move the Frame tool to another key.
notes: Raised by f-puts-a-video-full-screen-and-the-full-screen-s (acceptance: "If the person should get F for full screen there too ... raise it as a decision card with the key moves spelled out in the option labels"). Tool keys: PhotonzCore/Tools.swift shortcutKey (frame f, lens k). Player rule: PhotonzCore/PlayerFullScreen.swift command(for:watching:isFullScreen:) returns nil when not watching; widening it is where option b would land. Photoshop: F cycles screen modes, K is the Frame tool.
acceptance: The user has picked an option on the decision card

If F becomes full screen in the editor: F fills the screen and brings it back in both a picture and a recording, the Frame tool and Lens show their new keys in the tool bar tips and the tutorials, and no two tools share a key
If F stays the Frame tool: the task is retired with nothing changed

log.note: waiting on the decision card: F in the editor
